definition: A class D of facts is a parameter. ClosedUnderReasons A G a D says that every contingent reason at a of a fact in D is in D, which is the one formal commitment that D carries: a fact in D has no contingent reason outside D. A derivative fact is here only a fact outside D. Nothing says which facts are in D, and an aggregate is not by definition outside it.
